traderLens.name: Minervini
traderLens.view: Do not fight market distribution in premier market leaders. When previous market drivers crack key technical moving averages on heavy volume, progressive exposure rules dictate standing aside.

traderLens.name: Ted Zhang
traderLens.view: Clear institutional rotation out of megacap semiconductors into defensive industrials, aerospace, and energy. Capital isn't leaving equities entirely; it is dispersing to non-tech pockets.

traderLens.name: Clement Ang
traderLens.view: Market context is choppy to risk-off in tech. Setup grades for growth names degrade to C; sit tight and wait for higher-probability conditions to re-emerge.

traderLens.name: SRxTrades
traderLens.view: Avoid catching falling knives on pre-market gaps. Wait for the opening range to establish and look for volume dry-ups on pullbacks before considering entries.

traderLens.name: Jeff
traderLens.view: Discipline rule: Never average down on a breaking leader. Keep stops mechanical and honor risk budgets strictly.

traderLens.name: Qullamaggie
traderLens.view: Episodic pivots in defense (LUNR, AVEX) offer isolated momentum, but watch overall tape pressure. If market breadth drags, even good breakouts can fail.

traderLens.name: Composite
traderLens.view: Adopt a WAIT posture. Maintain low exposure, preserve cash, avoid chasing semiconductor dip-buys, and focus selective attention exclusively on names showing strong relative strength.
